<thought>To locate the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone, I will search the template catalog using the flavanone product SMILES “O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3CC(O)C4=CC=CC=C34”. The reaction breaks a ketone and an aromatic hydroxyl (functional_groups_broken: ["ketones","aromatic hydroxyls"]) and forms an ether oxygen (functional_groups_formed: ["ether oxygens"]). I will request up to 5 matching templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3CC(O)C4=CC=CC=C34",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
